C0189.title: CCTV 3·15 Gala Exposes Cloud-Controlled Livestream Popularity Inflation
C0189.summary: The 2023 CCTV 3·15 Gala exposed companies such as Shaanxi Yarunjin Network Technology that provided cloud-control systems able to bulk-like livestreams, inflate popularity, and increase displayed online viewers. The conduct used technical means to create fake popularity, mislead consumers, and interfere with platform recommendation algorithms.
